## New post

- [ ] Folder name is the URL I want (lower-case, hyphens)
- [ ] `title`, `date`, `author`, `tags` and `description` are set
- [ ] Images have alt text; the hero (if any) has `heroAlt`
- [ ] No `# Title` heading at the top of the post
- [ ] `draft: true` removed (or left in, if this is for review only)
